name: What is breathwork and how does it benefit functional fitness?
description: Breathwork is intentional breathing to improve physical and mental well-being, enhancing oxygen efficiency, stamina, and recovery in functional fitness.

mainEntity.name: What is breathwork and how does it benefit functional fitness?

acceptedAnswer.text: Breathwork involves intentional breathing techniques designed to improve physical and mental well-being. In functional fitness, it can enhance oxygen efficiency, increase stamina, and accelerate recovery. By consciously controlling your breath, you can improve core stability during exercises and manage stress, which contributes to better overall athletic performance. It helps connect the mind and body, optimizing movement patterns and reducing fatigue during intense workouts.
